# Transformers Mission 04: Encoder Block
#
# A transformer encoder block combines:
#   1. Multi-head self-attention
#   2. Residual connection (add & norm)
#   3. Feed-forward network (FFN)
#   4. Another residual connection (add & norm)
#
# The flow: x -> self-attention -> add+norm -> FFN -> add+norm -> output
#
# Your goal: Implement encoder_block(x, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, W_ff1, W_ff2, num_heads)
#   1. Compute self-attention: attn = multi_head_attention(x, ...)
#   2. Add residual + layer norm: x1 = layer_norm(x + attn)
#   3. Feed-forward: ffn = relu(x1 @ W_ff1) @ W_ff2
#   4. Add residual + layer norm: output = layer_norm(x1 + ffn)

import numpy as np

def layer_norm(x, eps=1e-5):
    mean = np.mean(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    std = np.std(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return (x - mean) / (std + eps)

def multi_head_attention(x, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, num_heads):
    Q = np.matmul(x, W_q)
    K = np.matmul(x, W_k)
    V = np.matmul(x, W_v)
    d_k = K.shape[-1] // num_heads
    heads = []
    for i in range(num_heads):
        q_h = Q[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        k_h = K[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        v_h = V[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        d_k_h = k_h.shape[-1]
        scores = np.matmul(q_h, k_h.T) / np.sqrt(d_k_h)
        e_x = np.exp(scores - np.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
        attn = e_x / np.sum(e_x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        heads.append(np.matmul(attn, v_h))
    concat = np.concatenate(heads, axis=-1)
    return np.matmul(concat, W_o)
